data.name: Tersina
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Tersina was a nymph who personified the fertile earth. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'teras' meaning harvest. Tersina was believed to protect and nurture crops, ensuring a bountiful harvest for her people.
